song_story.overview: Weekend is a 2021 single that plays like a small act of imagined freedom — waking up with no alarm, drinking coffee slowly, deciding on a whim to drive to the sea. There's no plot beyond that. It's a song about giving yourself permission to do absolutely nothing productive and calling that enough.
song_story.cultural_root: The song leans into 여유 (yeoyu) — a sense of unhurried space, room to breathe, the opposite of the 빨리빨리 (hurry-hurry) pace Korean daily life is famous for. Carving out real 여유, especially by yourself, is treated as a small rebellion. The lyric 혼자만의 영화관 ('a movie theater just for me') and the whole 'I can do whatever I want' hook are about claiming time that belongs to no one else's schedule or expectations.

verse_1.lines: 가장 가까운 바다, 혼자만의 영화관 / 그냥 이끌리는 대로 해도 괜찮으니까 / 울린 beep-beep-beep-beep 소리 / 귀에 윙윙윙 맴도는 / 나를 재촉하던 모닝콜 없이 일어나 / Cheesecake 한 입 / 유리 컵-컵-컵 한가득 / 내린 co-co-coffee 한 잔 / 아이스로 할래, 아주 여유롭게
verse_1.literal: Every morning / the beep-beep-beep-beep sound / buzzing around in my ears / I wake up without the wake-up call that used to rush me
verse_1.context: 재촉하다 means to rush or hurry someone along — the alarm is personified as something that pressures her every weekday. Waking up 없이 (without) it is the first small proof that this day belongs to her.

verse_2.lines: 문득 시곌 보니 벌써 시간은 열두시 / 그래도 아주 느긋해 / 그리곤 하품 한 번, 한껏 기지개도 켜고 / 생각해, 오늘 뭐 할까? / 창문 너머 계절에 시선이 닿은 그 순간 / 쏟아지는 햇살 내 맘을 두드려 / 내게 손짓하는 싱그러운 바람 타고서 / 떠나볼래 when the weekend comes / 바람 따라 흩어진 cloud
verse_2.literal: I glance at the clock and it's already noon / but I'm still completely relaxed / then one yawn, and I stretch as much as I can
verse_2.context: 느긋하다 (neugeutada) means unhurried, at ease — a key vocabulary word for this whole song's mood. Normally waking at noon would carry guilt; 그래도 ('even so') signals she's actively refusing that feeling.

pre_chorus.lines: 더 자유롭게 we can go (Hey) / 가장 가까운 바다, 혼자만의 영화관 / 그냥 이끌리는 대로 해도 괜찮으니까 / 훌쩍 떠나보는 drive, 뚜벅 걸어도 좋아 / 뭐든 발길 닿는 대로 지금 떠나보려 해, oh / 하루쯤 세상의 얘길 무시한 채 / 내가 나의 하루를 조립해 보려 해 / 더는 no, no stress, 고민 안 할래 / Move it right, left, right, 내 맘대로
pre_chorus.literal: The moment my eyes land on the season outside the window / the pouring sunlight knocks on my heart / riding the fresh wind that beckons to me
pre_chorus.context: 손짓하다 means to beckon, to wave someone over — nature itself is inviting her out. 두드리다 (to knock/tap) turns sunlight into something almost asking permission to come in, which mirrors the whole song's gentle, low-stakes tone.

chorus.lines: 가본 적도 없는 길 뭐가 있든지 / 이어 가보는 이윤 for a little fun / 계속 up, up, up 좀 더 올라가 / 한쪽 길모퉁이 따라 맘대로 자라난 / 조그만 이름 모를 꽃 (Da-la-da, da-da-da-la) / 한참을 바라보다 뜨거운 햇살을 피해 / 벤치에 잠깐 앉아 봐 (Oh) / 느려지는 걸음 그림자의 속도를 따라 / 함께 걷는 태양과 발을 맞추고
chorus.literal: I think I'll go, when the weekend comes / I can do whatever I want / clouds scattered by the wind / more freely, we can go
chorus.context: 떠나볼래 uses -아/어 볼래, 'I think I'll try to.' It's tentative, an invitation to herself rather than a firm plan — fitting for a song about spontaneity rather than itinerary.

verse_3.lines: 뒤이을 달빛을 따라 돌아오고 싶은 걸 / 떠나볼래 when the weekend comes / 바람 따라 흩어진 cloud / 더 자유롭게 we can go (Hey) / 아무 계획이 없어서 완벽한 plan / 우연히 찾아낸 secret place (Oh woah, woah, woah) / 그곳에 두고 와 나만의 작은 짐 (두고 와 내 작은 짐) / 골목길 끝을 돌아 만나게 될 / 기분 좋은 surprise 또 설렘 (Oh woah, woah, woah)
verse_3.literal: Ignoring the world's noise for just one day / I'm going to try assembling my own day myself / no more stress, I won't worry about it anymore
verse_3.context: 조립하다 literally means to assemble, like furniture — she's building the day from scratch with no obligations dictating its shape. -(으)ㄴ 채 ('while remaining in the state of X') on 무시한 채 emphasizes she's deliberately staying in the state of tuning everything out.

outro.lines: 두근두근 온종일 (하루 종일) / 고소한 향기의 coffee shop / 눈에 들어오는 예쁜 옷 (눈에 들어) / 맘에 들어오는 걸 더는 망설이긴 싫은 걸 / 그래도 돼 when the weekend comes / 바람 따라 흩어진 cloud / 더 자유롭게 we can go (Hey) / 가장 가까운 바다, 혼자만의 영화관 / 그냥 이끌리는 대로 해도 괜찮으니까 (On the weekend, oh, ooh, yeah) / 훌쩍 떠나보는 drive, 뚜벅 걸어도 좋아 / 뭐든 발길 닿는 대로 지금 떠나보려 해, oh
outro.literal: The nearest sea, a movie theater just for myself / because it's okay to just do whatever I'm drawn to
outro.context: 이끌리는 대로 — 'as I'm drawn/pulled,' -는 대로 meaning 'exactly as, according to however.' The whole song's philosophy compresses into this line: no destination required, just following instinct, and 괜찮으니까 (because it's fine) grants herself the permission upfront.

artist_context: Weekend came out in the middle of a run of TAEYEON solo releases that lean into groove-forward, city-pop-adjacent production, a contrast to the heavier ballads she's also known for. It reads as a deliberately lighter, warmer entry in her catalog.

grammar_highlights.usage: 'I think I'll try to ~.' 떠나볼래 — tentative, low-commitment intention, matching the song's easygoing mood.
'As, according to, following.' 이끌리는 대로 — 'as I'm drawn to' — doing something exactly following an impulse rather than a plan.
'While remaining in a state, without changing out of it.' 무시한 채 — 'while ignoring, leaving it ignored' — describes staying in a chosen state on purpose.
